implemented: Machine-readable exact pair handshake contracts in scripts/release-identity.mjs, scripts/release-evidence.mjs, and scripts/release-candidate.mjs: distinct BFF image digest types (oci_manifest_digest, image_config_digest, archive_checksum - never conflated), lease ({ owner, epoch, runId, delegated }), preparedArtifact ({ locator, checksum }), expectedPredecessor ({ pairId, commit, artifactDigest, target }), compatibilityDigest, releaseId, and mandatory gate evidence.

Positive prepare protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: stages exact dev-public-origin FE assets, qualifies candidate against staged non-public BFF via PANTHEON_BFF_CANDIDATE_TRANSPORT, leaves incumbent live symlink untouched, verifies genuine gate evidence (managementFleet, openclawContract, agoraCompatibility), emits durable prepared_success in release-evidence hash chain and writes .prepared-receipt.json with 29-field integrity hash, persisting durable evidence before exiting 0.

Positive activate protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: executes in a new process without rebuilding, verifies prepared receipt (29-field SHA-256 hash, non-future preparedAt <= now + 60s, TTL <= 3600s, expiresAt not expired, durable receipt match, checksum match) and fresh same-epoch environment lease (registered owner regex, epoch, runId, delegated=true), enforces expected predecessor CAS even on replay, checks all 5 mandatory gates (candidateVerification, preSwitchProbe, agoraCompatibility, managementFleet, openclawContract), atomically exchanges DEPLOY_ROOT symlink, and verifies independent served readback. Idempotent write replay succeeds without rebuilding or re-staging.

Strict restore protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: requires fully validated .prepared-receipt.json (schema, status, 29-field integrity hash, time bounds, mandatory gates, authorized lease owner regex) for write-proof releases, authenticates lease authority with delegated=true, owner, epoch, and runId matching receipt before switching to safe read-only sibling.
Retired one-shot public-switch bypass in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh without compatibility alias; unauthenticated or unphased execution fails closed with exit code 2.

Aligned proof watchdog caller and workflow in .github/workflows/pantheon-proof-watchdog.yml and .github/workflows/pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml to pass and verify lease parameters (owner, epoch, runId, delegated=true).

Gated write-proof proof coordinator in .github/workflows/pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml so deploy_action=prepare safely runs prepare without arming watchdog, activating, or running proof, exporting prepared_release_dir, prepared_receipt, prepared_locator, and prepared_receipt_checksum within 25-input workflow dispatch limit.

Updated .github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml to wire staged candidate transport to browser probe, write probes, management live deep, auth smoke, and identity verification curl; replaced retired sslip.io host with app.dev.mvl-cap.tw.

Hardened probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs: strict IPv4 loopback regex rejecting spoofed hostnames (e.g. 127.attacker.example), genuine browser CORS preflight check with OPTIONS dispatch validating allowed methods, headers, and credentials, and preserved candidate path prefixes in route fulfillment.
